title: Mayer–Vietoris sequence for derived Hom on a two-open cover
statement: Let (X, O_X) be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] covered by open subspaces U and V, and let D(O_X) be the derived category of sheaves of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and likewise for the opens. For any two objects E and F of D(O_X), there is an exact sequence from global Hom(E,F) to the direct sum of Hom between their restrictions to U and V, then to Hom between their restrictions to the intersection; the second map is the difference of restrictions. Exactness is asserted at global Hom (with the preceding negative Ext term) and at the direct-sum term (with the difference map), as in the beginning of the Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence.

proof.text: Use [lem-sc-open-hom-triangle-realization] to obtain a distinguished triangle A→B→E→A[1], additive identifications eB,eA,eN with the three local Hom groups and negative overlap Ext, and the restriction-pair and difference map identities. The exactness and additive restriction instances in the item supply every technical functor hypothesis.

Define negExt(x)=δ ≫ eN.symm(x). Additivity follows from additivity of eN.symm and categorical composition. For global Hom, eB injectivity identifies a pair of zero restrictions with b ≫ f=0; clause (ii) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] factors f through δ, giving the required preimage eN(g). Conversely b ≫ δ=0 makes every negExt image restrict to zero.

For a compatible local pair p put g=eB.symm(p). The difference identity and eA injectivity give a ≫ g=0. Clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] produces f with g=b ≫ f, and eB then gives the desired local pair. Conversely a ≫ b=0 and the same map identities make the difference of the restrictions of every global map zero. The two square-zero composites are the standard distinguished-triangle identities. The existing and generic nested restrictions agree by reflexivity.

lean.statement: theorem derived_hom_mayer_vietoris (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (U V : Opens X) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X).over U))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X).over V))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X).over (U ⊓ V)))] (E F : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))) : let R_U := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) U).mapDerivedCategory let R_V := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) V).mapDerivedCategory let R_UV := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) (U ⊓ V)).mapDerivedCategory ∃ (negExt : (R_UV.obj E ⟶ (R_UV.obj F)⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧) →+ (E ⟶ F)), Function.Exact negExt (fun f => (R_U.map f, R_V.map f)) ∧ Function.Exact (fun f : E ⟶ F => (R_U.map f, R_V.map f)) (fun p : (R_U.obj E ⟶ R_U.obj F) × (R_V.obj E ⟶ R_V.obj F) => derivedOpenHomRestriction X (homOfLE inf_le_left) p.1 - derivedOpenHomRestriction X (homOfLE inf_le_right) p.2)
